plain: Several pianists are widely regarded as masters of Bach's keyboard music. Glenn Gould is perhaps the most famous, renowned for his idiosyncratic but revelatory recordings of the Goldberg Variations and Well-Tempered Clavier. András Schiff is celebrated for his scholarly, elegant interpretations across Bach's complete keyboard works. Angela Hewitt is highly respected for her clarity and thoughtful phrasing, especially in the Well-Tempered Clavier and Partitas. Wilhelm Kempff and Rosalyn Tureck were also major 20th-century Bach interpreters, with Tureck specifically credited with reviving serious pianistic interest in Bach during an era when his keyboard music was less commonly performed on piano. More recently, Murray Perahia has released widely praised Bach recordings, bringing a warm, singing tone to the music.

It's generally hit with a higher net clearance and more margin for error than a flat serve, making it a reliable, safer option, especially for second serves, while still creating a challenging, awkward bounce for the opponent. plain: The Maya civilization built the temples found across the Yucatán Peninsula, constructing massive stone pyramids and ceremonial complexes at sites like Chichén Itzá, Uxmal, Tulum, and Cobá between roughly 250 and 900 CE, with some earlier and later activity as well. These structures served religious, astronomical, and political purposes, often aligned precisely with solar and celestial events, such as the famous serpent-shadow effect at Chichén Itzá's El Castillo pyramid during the equinoxes. The Maya developed sophisticated writing, mathematics (including the concept of zero), and calendar systems alongside this architecture. While the classic Maya cities in the southern lowlands largely declined by the 10th century, cities in the Yucatán continued to flourish for centuries afterward before Spanish colonization in the 16th century disrupted Maya civilization.

plain: Brazil has won the most FIFA World Cups, with five titles: 1958, 1962, 1970, 1994, and 2002. Brazil is also the only country to have played in every World Cup tournament since the competition began in 1930. Germany and Italy are tied for second place with four titles each, Germany's coming in 1954, 1974, 1990, and 2014, and Italy's in 1934, 1938, 1982, and 2006. Argentina has three titles (1978, 1986, and 2022), and France has two (1998 and 2018). Brazil's combination of consistent quality, iconic players like Pelé, and deep soccer culture has cemented its reputation as the most successful nation in World Cup history.

plain: Realistically, you can't do everything, so the real skill is prioritization rather than pure time management. Start by identifying your genuine priorities, the few things that matter most to your goals and wellbeing, and be honest about what can be deprioritized, delegated, or dropped entirely. Time-blocking, scheduling specific chunks of your calendar for focused work rather than relying on a loose to-do list, tends to be far more effective than trying to fit tasks in reactively. Batch similar tasks together (emails, errands, calls) to avoid constant context-switching, which is a major hidden time drain. Build in buffer time between commitments, since back-to-back scheduling leaves no room for the inevitable overruns or interruptions. Finally, protect time for rest and recovery as seriously as you protect work time, since burnout ultimately costs you far more time than it saves.
